report.title: CERT-In Directions (2022) - Incident Logging & Reporting Report
report.author: DBDOME Security Team (dbexpert.ai)

sections.text: CERT-In Directions 2022 - Database Logging & Incident Reporting

sections.content: Compliance evidence aligned to the CERT-In Directions (No. 20(3)/2022) requirements for logging, synchronized activity records, tamper-proof retention and timely incident reporting, generated automatically by the DBDOME platform.

sections.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS incidents_30d, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at - detected_at <= INTERVAL '6 hours') AS logged_within_6h, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state NOT IN ('CLOSED','RESOLVED')) AS open_incidents FROM log.incidents WHERE detected_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
sections.template: Last 30 days: {incidents_30d} incidents; {logged_within_6h} recorded within the CERT-In 6-hour window; {open_incidents} still open. Recorded incidents are forwarded to the SIEM for onward CERT-In reporting.

sections.query: SELECT incident_id, title, severity, category, state, detected_at, created_at, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (created_at - detected_at))/3600.0, 2) AS hours_to_log FROM log.incidents WHERE detected_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 25
SELECT tl.incident_id, tl.event_type, tl.actor, tl.note, tl.event_time FROM log.incident_timeline tl WHERE tl.event_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY tl.event_time DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT server) AS servers_logged, COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS detection_rules, COUNT(*) AS log_events_7d FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results WHERE entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
sections.template: Continuous logging: {servers_logged} databases, {detection_rules} detection rules, {log_events_7d} activity/telemetry records captured in the last 7 days.

sections.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', entry_date) AS day, COUNT(*) AS events FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results WHERE entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
sections.title: Daily Activity-Logging Volume (14 days)
sections.caption: Continuity of database activity logging across the estate

sections.query: SELECT table_name, rows_hashed, last_hashed_id, verified_at, CASE WHEN is_valid THEN 'INTACT' ELSE 'BROKEN' END AS chain_status, broken_at_id, error_detail FROM log.hash_chain_checkpoints ORDER BY verified_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 25

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, (gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count')::int AS events, COALESCE(gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity','high') AS severity, gm.entry_date AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE (gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC06%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC09%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-AUD-027%%') AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 25
